title: Fix Career RPG question card dark-mode contrast

spec.problem: In dark mode, the selected answer in BjtStyleQuestionCard uses hardcoded bg-[#EEF2FF] while globals.css remaps text-[#111827] to near-white, making the selected option invisible (~1.1:1).

acceptance.text: BjtStyleQuestionCard uses theme tokens instead of hardcoded light hex colors; picked and unpicked options use theme-aware background/border/badge tokens ensuring >=4.5:1 contrast in both light and dark mode.

spec.expected_behavior: Option text and badges in BjtStyleQuestionCard use theme tokens (bg-surface, bg-paper, bg-accent-soft, bg-brand-panel, border-border, border-brand-navy, text-ink, text-muted) with zero hardcoded hex colors.
spec.observed_behavior: Picked choice uses border-[#1B2A4A] bg-[#EEF2FF] and text-[#111827], causing white-on-#EEF2FF in dark mode.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert bjt-style-question-card.tsx and its test file.

red_targets.test: BjtStyleQuestionCard > uses theme tokens for picked and unpicked states with no hardcoded light hex colors
